scope: Behavior-preserving split of src/gameplay_menu_browser.cpp by scene with one-field-per-line JSON observers. Compiled, source identified and headless Chrome exercised at original CSS only. No timing, performance, pixel, PCM, physical-input or retail-comparison claim.

machine.browser: installed Google Chrome 154.0.8037.98, headless, host speakers silent

wasm_interface.method: Parse the Wasm import and export sections. RelWithDebInfo keeps names and compares them directly. Release builds minify names, so each export and import is compared by the JS name the Emscripten glue binds, with kind and Wasm signature.

runtime_release.classification: Native API entries matched; only the listed generated Emscripten helper names differ.

runtime_public_release.classification: Native API entries matched; only the listed generated Emscripten helper names differ.

runtime_audio_preview_release.classification: Native API entries matched; only the listed generated Emscripten helper names differ.

difference_cause.function: report_construction(char const*, double, double, double, AuroraStats const&, AuroraStats const&)
difference_cause.baseline: internal linkage; argument promotion turned the 'before' reference into two scalar arguments, so the Wasm function took 7 parameters (i32,f64,f64,f64,i32,i32,i32)
difference_cause.split: external linkage (shared with the menu unit); keeps the 6 declared parameters (i32,f64,f64,f64,i32,i32)
difference_cause.emscripten_helper: exception-invoke trampoline pair generated from that signature
difference_cause.classification: Generated helper ABI difference caused by linkage; native API contract did not change.

function_inventory_release_runtime.normalization: anonymous namespace mapped to melee_web_menu_browser; trailing numeric uniquifiers removed
classes: helpers now external and kept out of line

runtime_public_release.only_before: window.menuPreparation?.(UTF8ToString($0)) from the replay export that the public player forbids; no Wasm code in the baseline references its address

runtime_audio_preview_release.only_before: same dead string as the public build

observer_format_proof.method: For each converted snprintf call: same destination buffer and size, concatenated add() fragments equal the original format string, and ordered arguments equal the original, with TARGET_PC defined and undefined. Combined with tests/test_fixed_format_writer.py (writer equals one snprintf at every buffer size, including truncation).

observer_capture.scenario: Import the owned disc, reach original CSS, wait 3 seconds, read observers, unload, read observers again. Two runs per build.
observer_capture.memory_differences: allocator_* fields only; live and free values also differ between two runs of one build, arena and top-free differ between builds with cause not isolated; wasm_heap_bytes and all source_* fields equal

menuPreparationProfile.note: not emitted on this route; PreparationProfile::report is covered by the format proof only

observer_capture.not_covered_at_runtime: populated match_observe, results_pad_trace samples and results_entry_packet need a match and Results route; their format and arguments are covered by the static proof

full_suite.skip_reasons: owned DOL, fighter archives, built traces and other local inputs absent in this checkout

smoke.command: scripts/browser_smoke.mjs --surface development with the owned disc on the RelWithDebInfo development build

indicative_cost.method: host-native clang -O2, about 55 doubles and 8 integers, best of 5 runs of 200000 calls
indicative_cost.claim: indicative only; not a Wasm measurement

historical_evidence_scope: Root-level build, interface, function, serializer, observer, smoke, and indicative-cost fields retain the earlier comparison against historical baseline 07bcfdf. Current-base revalidation is recorded separately below.
